      export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = resource_expenses_compare parameters = { resource = trade } variable = pe_safe_margin_trade }
      multiply_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_trade value = 0.05 }
      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_trade value < 10 } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_margin_trade value = 10 } }

      set_variable = { which = pe_safe_reserved_trade value = 0 }
    every_owned_colony = { every_deposit = { limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_sites }

      planet = { pe_safe_vector = yes root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_safe_reserved_energy value = pe_sc_energy } subtract_variable = { which = pe_safe_reserved_minerals value = pe_sc_minerals } subtract_variable = { which = pe_safe_reserved_food value = pe_sc_food } subtract_variable = { which = pe_safe_reserved_consumer_goods value = pe_sc_consumer_goods } subtract_variable = { which = pe_safe_reserved_trade value = pe_sc_trade } } }
    } }
    set_country_flag = pe_safe_ready
